messages:
Ava (CS): Heads-up: client Halcyon wants to move to Net60 and shorten to 9 months. They submitted PO HAL-0926 but vendor_code doesn't match our invoicing entity. Need decision on onboarding and revenue path. cc @Ravi (AE)

Ravi (AE): Procurement insists Net60. They sent signed PO but used HALCY-GLOBAL vendor_code. Asked if we can accept with an addendum confirming invoice goes to HALCY-UK.

Tess (Finance): Finance: acceptable only with a signed addendum or a 30% wire as security. Otherwise we keep credit-hold. Also need PO to reference SOW exactly (HAL-2026-09).

Marc (Legal): I'll draft a short "Entity & Terms Addendum" (references SOW, Net60, late fee 1.5%/mo). If signed we can proceed; otherwise no full provisioning.

Ava (CS): For onboarding: offer limited provisioning (integration support, no Dedicated capacity) while paperwork completes. Communicated to PMs.

OpsBot: Onboarding ticket created: HALCY-0926. Steps: upload addendum, validate PO, release credit hold. Link: https://console.redwood.example/onboard/HALCY-0926

Ravi (AE): Sent addendum to procurement lead emma.daly@halcyon.com. She replied "will sign today" and attach updated PO.

Tess (Finance): Once signed addendum + PO are uploaded, Finance will lift credit hold and create invoice (Net60).

Marc (Legal): Addendum received and countersigned. Uploading to contract repo and emailing payments@redwood.

Ava (CS): Received confirmation. Enabling limited provisioning; full Dedicated allocation will wait for invoice posting. Updating renewal tracker: status = pending-invoice.

Tess (Finance): Invoice HAL-2026-09 created (Net60). Scheduling reminders for day 45 & 55. Closing loop when payment posts.

Ava (CS): Thanks team — I'll notify customer and schedule integration kickoff with capacity note.
